schema_version.description: Export schema version; bump on any breaking shape change.

exported_at.description: UTC time the exporter ran; freshness is measured from this.

sensor.description: Identity and status of the sensor box that produced this export.

id.description: Stable identifier for this sensor box.

public_ip_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sensor's public IP — the plaintext IP never leaves the box.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the sensor itself, if known.

protocols.description: Protocol names the sensor listens on (e.g. SSH, TNET — knock-knock's identifier for Telnet).

uptime_minutes.description: Minutes the sensor has been continuously running.

knockknock_version.description: Version string of the knock-knock honeypot software in use.

ring_reset_at.description: Timestamp of the last counter reset (DB reset/prune), if one occurred.

totals.description: All-time knock totals for the sensor.

knocks_total.description: All-time count of knocks recorded by the sensor.

since.description: Timestamp the sensor's all-time totals have been accumulating since.

unique_ips_7d.description: Distinct public source IPs (the sensor's own excluded) active in the last 7 days, counted from the box's delta ring — NOT capped by top_ips (maxItems 2000). Optional: exports before 2026-09-17 lack it, and the pipeline then counts active top_ips rows instead.

bucket_minutes.description: Width of each ring bucket in minutes; always 30.

by_protocol.description: Per-protocol knock totals, most active first.

hits_7d.description: Knocks on this protocol in the last 7 days.

top_ips.description: Public source IPs that knocked, most active first.

ip.description: Public source IP literal (IPv4 or IPv6).

hits_7d.description: Knocks from this IP in the last 7 days.

first_seen.description: Timestamp this IP was first observed. Present only when the sensor records it — knock-knock v3 keeps no per-IP first-seen, so P1 exports omit it.

last_seen.description: Timestamp this IP was last observed.

protocols.description: Per-protocol hit breakdown for this IP.

hits_total.description: All-time knocks from this IP on this protocol (knock-knock keeps no per-IP, per-protocol time window, so no 7-day figure exists here). Whether the IP was active this week is the parent row's hits_7d.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for this IP, if known.

asn.description: Autonomous system number for this IP, if known.

isp.description: ISP/organization name for this IP's ASN, if known.

lat.description: Latitude of this IP's geolocation, if resolved.

lng.description: Longitude of this IP's geolocation, if resolved.

geo_precision.description: Granularity of the resolved geolocation for this IP.

top_usernames.description: aggregate values only — never paired, hits_7d ≥ 3 by schema

top_passwords.description: aggregate values only — never paired, hits_7d ≥ 3 by schema

top_countries.description: Source countries by knock volume, most active first.

hits_7d.description: Knocks from this country in the last 7 days.

top_isps.description: Source ISPs/organizations by knock volume, most active first.

asn.description: Autonomous system number for this ISP, if known.

hits_7d.description: Knocks from this ISP in the last 7 days.

credlist.description: Top aggregate credential values, fenced and never paired.

value.description: The fenced credential value (username or password), standalone — never paired.

hits_7d.description: Occurrences of this value in the last 7 days; floored at 3 so singletons never publish.
